apps.name: Lumisound
apps.subtitle: Spatial music player with 8D audio, EQ, and personal cloud library
apps.localizedDescription: Lumisound is a full-featured iOS music player with 10-band EQ, 8D spatial audio, crossfade, gapless playback, AB repeat, sleep timer, lyrics, personal cloud library, and SoundCloud/YouTube streaming.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Lumisound reads your music library to display and play your songs.
